body:
Moves the platform app from `apps/web` to `src` (plan "Ratel consolidation", RP-34, decision move-on-integration).

## Contains (merge after them)

This branch starts at `main` and merges the heads of these open PRs with `git merge --no-ff`, in this order. **Merge this PR after all of them.**

1. #367 installer
2. #368 cloud deployer
3. #369 deploy buttons
4. #376 RC-853 foreign-project evals
5. #377 Quality removal
6. #378 flags port
7. #379 ratel-cloud ports
8. #380 Agents and MCP pages
9. #381 SDKs moved to ratel-ai/ratel-sdk. It empties `src/`, and the plan puts the SDK move first.

Twin: ratel-platform `refactor/move-apps-web-to-src`. Merge this one first.

## Commits of its own

- **`refactor: move apps/web to src`**: the rename. `git mv apps/web src`, plus every path that named it: Dockerfile, `next.config.ts` (`#ee-composition` alias, tracing root), tsconfig `@ee/*`, `link-ee.mjs`, `check-ee-boundary.mjs`, `check-layers.mjs`, `ci-filters`, `ci.yml`, `biome.json`, dependabot, the pnpm workspace, the lock importer key, the gitleaks allowlist, docs and ADRs. `platform-sync` keeps upstream (ratel-cloud) source paths in `apps/web` and lands destinations in `src` (`rewrite-imports.mjs` now has separate source and destination prefixes). `.gitleaksignore` is unchanged, because it pins old commits.
- **`fix(mcp): get_flag_status lists core flags only`**: #378 types the list as `CoreFlag`, and #379 adds `FF_TOOL_RUN_INSIGHTS`, an env-only switch. Together they fail typecheck. The switch leaves the list until it becomes a `CoreFlag` (follow-up). Its gate is unchanged.
- **`fix(biome): keep owned foreign-run test out of the copy override`**: #376 maps `foreign-run.integration.test.ts` as owned, but its `biome.json` does not exclude it. #376 needs the same line.
- **`ci: classify changed paths from stdin`**: this PR changes 3,275 paths (154 KB of JSON). Passed as an env value, that list goes over the kernel's 128 KB limit for one string, and the `changes` job dies with no output. The list now goes in on stdin.
- **`fix(mcp): stage the Agents and MCP servers tools`**: #380 publishes four tools with no `TOOL_STAGES` entry, so `stages.test` fails when they are on. They get `monitor`, as on ratel-cloud main.

- **`test(mcp): pin the Agents and MCP servers tools' stage`**: the tools fixture, regenerated. Only those four `_meta` stages change.
- **`test(task-evals): let the no-key refusal read the foreign-project check`**: #376 checks for a foreign project before the model (as upstream does), which adds three reads on the no-key path. The fake now answers exactly five reads. A sixth read or any write still fails the test. #376 needs this too.
- **`ci(gitleaks): allow fixtures under apps/web and src`**: a full scan reads history, where the fixtures are still under `apps/web`.
- **`ci(deploy): build the ARM template through az bicep`**: #369 called `~/.azure/bin/bicep`, which `az bicep install` does not always create (exit 127). #369 needs this too.

## Monorepo leftovers (RP-35, commit `RP-35 chore: drop monorepo leftovers`)

#381 already removed `src/` (SDKs), `protocol/`, `packages/sdk`, `examples/`, `e2e/`, the Cargo and Rust files, and the SDK scripts and workflows. This commit removes what was left:

| Removed | Reason |
|---|---|
| `biome.json` includes `benchmark/agent/src/**/*.ts(x)` | `benchmark/` no longer exists |
| `.dockerignore` `benchmark/` | same |
| `.gitignore` Python block (`__pycache__`, `*.py[cod]`, `*.egg*`, `build/`, `.venv`, pytest/mypy/ruff caches, `*.whl`) | no Python left in the repository |
| `.gitignore` SDK demo scratch (`embedding_demo.*`, `embedding_usage_demo.*`, `adaptive_demo*`) | SDK demos, now in ratel-sdk |

Kept on purpose: `packages/brand` and `packages/design-system` (used by `src` and ratel-platform). `dist/` in `.gitignore` (MCP Apps views and package builds). `docs/baseline-capture-distributed.md`, an SDK guide that ratel-sdk does not have yet. The SDK ADRs, which stay as decision history. The root package name `ratel-monorepo`, which is only a label of a workspace that still has four packages.

## Merge resolutions

- #379 into #378, then #380 (`lib/mcp/operations/account.ts`, `lib/mcp/route-handler.test.ts`): each side added one flag to the switch list. Both are kept.
- #381 into the deploy PRs (`ci.yml`, `.lycheeignore`, `scripts/ci-filters.mjs`): the SDK jobs and outputs are removed. The deploy output, the `deploy` job and the install/deploy script tests are kept. The deploy filter tests no longer assert the removed `sdk`/`rust`/`python` outputs.

## CI on the pair

- ratel (workflow_dispatch, because draft PRs skip CI): [run 44958945146](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel/actions/runs/44958945146) is green on e396256e. That covers the OSS Docker build (`platform-build`), `platform-compose`, the four test shards, `deploy`, `secret-scan` and `dependency-scan`.
- ratel-platform #118: [run 44955882363](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel-platform/actions/runs/44955882363) is green. That covers the Cloud Docker build (`cloud`) and the four test shards against this branch.

## Checks run locally

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`: passes with the three-line lock edit.
- Typecheck: OSS and Cloud (twin at `ee/src`) both pass.
- `check:boundary`, `check:layers`, `check:private`: clean. Biome: clean.
- `node --test scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/platform-sync/sync.test.mjs`: 166 pass.
- ee db and identity tests that read core migrations from `src/`: 18 pass.

## Proof

Final pair: ratel `9ceeae3f`, ratel-platform `c0d67c56` (both `refactor/move-apps-web-to-src`).

- CI on the pair is green. ratel: [run 44960332927](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel/actions/runs/44960332927) (OSS Docker build, compose, tests, deploy, scans). ratel-platform: [run 44960334906](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel-platform/actions/runs/44960334906) (Cloud Docker build, tests).
- Local Cloud boot: `next build` with `RATEL_COMPOSITION=cloud`, then the standalone `src/server.js` as the image runs it, `DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=1`, and a fresh Postgres migrated by `ee/src/db/bundle-migrator.mjs`. `GET /api/health` answers `{"status":"ok","edition":"Ratel Cloud"}`. `/` goes to `/organizations`, and the Cloud launch gate shows the waitlist.

![Local Cloud boot on src](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel/blob/proof/rp-34/01-cloud-boot.png?raw=true)

Records (PR records, leftovers list, CI job conclusions, logs): [proof/rp-34](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel/tree/proof/rp-34).
